highlights.headline: Commission approves €1 billion Slovak State aid scheme to support cleantech manufacturing capacity
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Jun 2026 The European Commission has approved a €1 billion Slovak scheme to support clean technology (cleantech) manufacturing capacity in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy. The scheme was approved under the Clean Industrial Deal State Aid Framework (CISAF) adopted by the Commission on 25 June 2025.

items.title: The ocean has shielded us from the worst of climate change. Now it is running a fever | Karina Von Schuckmann
items.description: <p>Nearly every indicator of climate change is flashing red. But we still hold the tools available to bring the planet back into balance</p><p>The ocean is running a fever. In 2025, the number of days of marine heatwaves – prolonged spells when the sea turns abnormally, dangerously warm – was more than triple what it was in the early 1990s.</p><p>These are not abstract statistics. items.title: CRISPR gene-editing for crops: Precision tool or new risk?
items.description: The EU has eased restrictions on crops developed using novel genetic techniques. While supporters say the technology could help farmers adapt to climate change, critics argue its effects remain poorly understood.

items.title: EU, G7 pledge support amid DRC Ebola outbreak
items.description: G7 leaders called for a "strong and coordinated response" to the latest Ebola outbreak. The EU's Ursula von der Leyen said that "health security is shared security." The recorded death toll in DRC is approaching 200.
